stories.title: Bernie Sanders proposes banning ‘superintelligence’ and putting violators in prison
stories.simple_summary: Senator Bernie Sanders introduced a bill that would make it illegal to create very advanced AI systems, with jail time for violators.
stories.why_it_matters: This is politics and law — nothing you need to worry about acting on right now, but it shows the government is thinking about AI safety rules.

stories.title: Sanders, Casar introduce ‘superintelligence’ ban
stories.simple_summary: Senator Bernie Sanders and another politician introduced a bill to ban the most powerful future AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a political story — the same as item 0 above.

stories.title: Sen. Bernie Sanders unveils bill to ban artificial superintelligence and create Department of AI
stories.simple_summary: Senator Bernie Sanders proposed a bill to ban superintelligence (the most powerful future AI) and create a government department to oversee AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about government regulation — honestly, it's mostly relevant to investors and politicians, not something affecting your daily life yet.

stories.title: YouTube is building AI creator tools that do almost everything for them
stories.simple_summary: YouTube is building AI tools that help creators make videos and get them seen by more people automatically.
stories.why_it_matters: If you or someone you know makes videos on YouTube, this could eventually save you time and help more people find your content.

stories.title: Spotify’s is giving you the keys to its recommendation algorithm with US launch of ‘Taste Profile’
stories.simple_summary: Spotify is letting listeners see exactly how its AI understands their music taste and lets you change it in plain language (like saying 'play less pop').
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Spotify, you now have more control over what music it suggests to you, which could make your recommendations better.

stories.title: Ema raises $77M as AI starts eating into enterprise software and services
stories.simple_summary: A company called Ema raised a lot of money because its AI software is starting to replace expensive business software that companies used to hire people or pay for.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it shows AI is changing how businesses buy software and services.

stories.title: OpenAI nabs key Patreon execs ahead of upcoming announcement
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI hired three people who used to run Patreon (a platform where creators get paid by fans) to help it build tools for creators.
stories.why_it_matters: This suggests OpenAI is planning to build tools to help content creators make money — details aren't clear yet.

stories.title: ‘We’re already fighting yesterday’s battle’: Greece’s prime minister gets candid about AI
stories.simple_summary: Greece's prime minister said that governments aren't ready for how much AI will change society.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a political observation — it reflects that leaders are worried about AI but don't have clear plans yet.

stories.title: Trump wants AI to be rebranded as super intelligence. Will it work?
stories.simple_summary: Trump wants people to call AI 'super intelligence' instead of 'artificial intelligence' and is trying to rebrand the term.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly just a naming debate — it won't change how AI actually works or affects you.

stories.title: Can artificial intelligence help the agriculture industry save water? Two high schoolers in Idaho say 'yes'
stories.simple_summary: Two high school students in Idaho used AI to help farmers save water on their crops.
stories.why_it_matters: If you farm or care about water conservation, AI tools like this could eventually help you use less water and save money.

stories.title: OpenAI wants to consult elite mathematicians about how to not fumble again
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI made mistakes handling math discoveries and is now asking expert mathematicians for advice on how to handle future research better.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to researchers and investors — it's about how AI companies manage scientific work, not something affecting ordinary people.

stories.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit’s agenda revealed: Unlock fundraising, hiring, and AI insights in Boston on November 4
stories.simple_summary: TechCrunch is advertising a conference for startup founders about fundraising, hiring, and using AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is only relevant if you're starting a tech business — otherwise it's just an advertisement for a business event.
